I wrote `component.html` in the task folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It follows `DESIGN.md` and has the content you listed.

- **Self-contained:** the day-theme tokens from `tokens.css` are inlined, because the file can't link another stylesheet. Unbounded and Archivo aren't available as assets, so it falls back to `system-ui`.
- **Layout:** a 1280px `#component` on white, with a centered 1120px column. The "Requests" title and the ink "New Request" button share the top row.
- **Toolbar:** below it sit the labeled search field and the All, Open and Closed filters. All is a Secondary button with a border, and Open and Closed are Quiet buttons.
- **Table:** it sits in a card with 52px rows and dividers. Every status value, including Approved, Closed and In review, uses the same blue pill, since the design file defines only one pill style.

The mock has no placeholder text in the search field.
